description: This file contains functions for parsing markdown specifications and transforming them into TypeScript test code, including handling fixtures, seed files, and test steps with annotations.

methods.name: transformMDToTS
methods.description: Transforms markdown code into TypeScript test code with source maps, handling fixtures, seed files, and test annotations.

methods.name: resolveFixtures
methods.description: Resolves fixture file paths relative to the current filename.

methods.name: escapeString
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe inclusion in generated code.

methods.name: parsingError
methods.description: Creates an error object with context about parsing failures.

methods.name: asText
methods.description: Extracts text content from markdown nodes, with error handling.

methods.name: parseSpec
methods.description: Parses markdown content into a structured representation with description, tests, and properties.

methods.name: parseProp
methods.description: Parses a property key-value pair from markdown list item.

methods.name: parseProps
methods.description: Parses multiple properties from a markdown list.

methods.name: parseTest
methods.description: Parses a test block from markdown nodes, extracting title, steps, and properties.
